name: HoneyVid
description: Official HoneyVid MCP server: put a person, pet or character from one photo into a trending AI video template, or generate videos and images with Playground models (Kling, Veo, Seedance and more). Every run is quoted in credits first and accepts a max-credit cap; generation uses paid HoneyVid credits. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1.
author: Beundra AB
